captions.detailed: This 3D model features a track fixie crankset assembly. It consists of a central black bottom-bracket shell housing a spindle, a silver right-hand crank arm with an integrated 5-arm spider, a large silver 48T chainring with pointed triangular teeth, a silver left-hand crank arm bolted to the opposite side, and two black rectangular rat-trap style pedals. The entire crankset assembly rotates continuously around the central spindle axle, while each pedal is mounted on a stub axle at the end of its respective crank arm to allow independent continuous rotation.
captions.instruction: Generate a track fixie crankset assembly with a central black bottom-bracket shell, a square-taper spindle, a silver right crank arm with a 5-arm spider, a silver 48T toothed chainring, a silver left crank arm offset by 180 degrees, and two black rectangular pedals. Ensure the spindle rotates continuously relative to the shell, and both pedals rotate continuously relative to their respective crank arm tips.
captions.factory: The code constructs the crankset by defining several parts: a bottom-bracket shell as a black cylinder, a spindle as a square-profile extrusion, left and right crank arms using lofted profiles with circular and square boss extrusions, a chainring made by patterning 48 triangular teeth around a thin disk with a 5-arm bolted spider pattern, and two pedals modeled as rectangular boxes with central cutouts. These parts are assembled using continuous articulations: one joint for the spindle rotating within the shell, and two separate joints for each pedal rotating on stub axles at the crank arm tips.
